summary: Salomon Lefmann worked in Indology and linguistics. He studied at Humboldt University of Berlin under Franz Bopp (~1861–1864) and held a post in Sanskrit at Heidelberg University from circa 1870 to 1912.

Sam Harris is a scholar in philosophy and other fields. He studied at Stanford University (~1986–2000), under Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche (~1990–1996) and Nyoshul Khenpo Jamyang Dorje (~1995–1999), and at the University of California, Los Angeles in 2009.

Sam van Schaik works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at the University of Manchester (~1996–2002) and under Lama Jampa Thaye, Karma Thinley Rinpoche, and Sakya Trizin. He held posts at the British Library (~2003–2017 and ~2017).
Samani Pratibha Pragya works in religious studies and Indology. She completed her PhD at SOAS University of London, where she also served as a research assistant (attested 2020).

Samdhong Rinpoche is a Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy scholar. He studied at Drepung Monastery, under the 14th Dalai Lama, and at Gyuto Monastery (-1970). He served as principal (~1977–2001) and director (1988) at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies.

Samten Gyaltsen Karmay works in Tibetology and religious studies. He studied at Drepung Monastery and SOAS/University of London under David L. Snellgrove. He held posts at SOAS (1961), CNRS (Directeur de Recherche, 1980), and served as president of the IATS (1996).

Samuel Beal was a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology. He earned a B.A. from Trinity College, Cambridge (~1843–1847) and served as Professor of Chinese at University College London and the University of London (~1877–1889).
Samuel M. Grupper is a scholar of Iranian and Central Asian studies, sinology, and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at Indiana University, where he studied under Irving Yucheng Lo and Philip West.

Sandra A. Wawrytko specializes in philosophy, sinology, and Buddhist studies. She served as Professor (attested 1999) and Associate Professor of Philosophy (attested 2014) at San Diego State University.
Sandra Bell is a scholar of religious studies and Buddhist studies. She completed her doctoral thesis at Durham University by 1991 and held a post there.
Sandra Hochwarter works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. She earned her Mag.phil. at the University of Vienna, where she studied under Klaus-Dieter Mathes and Anne MacDonald.
Sang-Kyun Sun specializes in Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at the University of Delhi under Sanghasen Singh (attested 1995) and served as a lecturer at JinGak Sangha College (attested 1995).

Sangay Dorji works in Tibetology, linguistics, and Buddhist studies. He studied at Tengtho Monastery and Simtokha Dzong, later teaching at Simtokha Dzong and serving as Secretary of the Dzongkha Development Commission.
Sangharakshita was a scholar of Buddhist studies and religious studies who studied under C. M. Chen (~1950–1962). He founded the Triratna Buddhist Community in 1968.

Sangseraima Ujeed specializes in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. She completed her doctorate at the University of Oxford (~2013–2018) and held a postdoctoral fellowship at the University of California, Santa Barbara (~2018–2020).
Sangye Tenzin was a Tibetology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Drepung Monastery. He later served as Abbot of Menri Monastery.

Sanjay Subrahmanyam is a historian who studied at Sardar Patel Vidyalaya, the University of Delhi, and the Delhi School of Economics. His posts include EHESS (~1995–2002), University of Oxford (~2002–2004), UCLA (~2004), and Collège de France (~2013–2021).
Sanjit Kumar Sadhukhan works in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. He studied under Mrinalkanti Gangopadhyaya (attested 1994) and A. P. Lama.

Sanjukta Gupta works in Indology and religious studies. She studied at the University of Calcutta, Visva-Bharati University, and Utrecht University under Jan Gonda. Her posts include Jadavpur University (~1961–1967), Utrecht University (~1971–1986), and University of Oxford (~1990–2000).
Sanne Dokter-Mersch is an Indology scholar who completed her PhD at Leiden University (~2016–2021) under the supervision of Peter Bisschop and Yuko Yokochi.
